subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Graded reader 1: The Lost Phone
outcomes: I can follow and order the events of The Lost Phone.
I can understand the words coach, strong wind, bush and tail.
I can suggest rules to keep my devices safe.

tf.s: Jake and Finn are going to London.
tf.why: Yes, they are on their way to London.

tf.s: The family took a coach because they couldn’t take their car.
tf.why: They had to travel by coach.

tf.s: From the window, the boys could see lots of camels.
tf.why: They could see fields, hills and lots of cows.

tf.s: On the coach, Jake was watching a video on his smartphone.
tf.why: He was watching a video with headphones.

tf.s: Jake’s phone fell out of the window because of a strong wind.
tf.why: A strong wind came and the phone fell out.

tf.s: Finn saw a cat moving under a bush.
tf.why: Finn saw a rabbit moving under a bush.

tf.s: The phone was under the rabbit’s tail.
tf.why: Yes, they found it under the rabbit’s tail.

tf.s: Jake was sad at the end of the story.
tf.why: He was very happy because he found his phone.

tf.s: The phone fell out before they took selfies.
tf.why: First they took selfies, then the phone fell out.

tf.s: Holding your phone out of an open window is a safe idea.
tf.why: It is not safe; the phone can fall out, like in the story.

boxes.q: Where are Jake and Finn going?
boxes.why: They are on their way to London.

boxes.q: Why did they travel by coach?
boxes.why: They couldn’t take their car, so they had to take a coach.

boxes.q: What animal did Finn see under a bush?

boxes.why: The phone was under the rabbit’s tail.

boxes.q: What did the strong wind do?
o: It made the phone fall out of the window.
boxes.why: The wind came and the phone fell out.

boxes.q: What did the boys do before the phone fell out?

o: a big bus for long trips
boxes.why: People travel by coach between cities.

boxes.q: What was Jake using with his phone on the coach?
boxes.why: He watched a video with headphones.

boxes.q: Why was Jake very happy at the end?
o: He found his phone and saw the funny selfies.
boxes.why: Finding the phone and the funny selfies made him happy.

boxes.q: Which is a good rule for a trip?
o: Keep your phone inside, away from open windows.
Hold your phone out of the window.
Give your phone to a stranger.
boxes.why: Keeping it inside stops it falling out.

hunt.q: The boys could see lots of…
The phone fell because of a strong…
Finn saw a ___ under a bush.
The phone was under the rabbit’s…
How did Jake feel at the end?

mcq.q: What could the boys see from the window?
o: fields, hills and lots of cows
mcq.why: They saw fields, hills and lots of cows.

mcq.q: How did Jake lose his phone?
o: A strong wind came and it fell out of the window.
He left it in a café.
He dropped it in the sea.
mcq.why: The wind made the phone fall out of the window.

mcq.q: What did Jake have to type on the phone?
mcq.why: In the story, the password was typed on the phone.
Finn saw a rabbit moving under a bush.

mcq.q: Put in order: a) They took selfies. b) The phone fell out. c) They are on their way to London.
mcq.why: First the trip, then the selfies, then the phone fell out.

mcq.q: Correct the sentence: “They could see lots of camels.”
o: They could see lots of cows.
They could see lots of rabbits.
They could see lots of cats.
mcq.why: The story says lots of cows.

mcq.q: Choose the correct sentence about the story.
o: They had to take a coach.
They have to took a coach.
They had to taking a coach.
They has to take a coach.
mcq.why: had to + base verb: had to take.

mcq.q: Why is the story called The Lost Phone?
o: Because Jake loses his phone and then finds it.
Because Finn buys a new phone.
Because the rabbit has a phone.
mcq.why: The main problem in the story is the lost phone.

mcq.q: What can we learn from the story?
o: Be careful with devices when you travel.
mcq.why: The phone was lost because it was near an open window.

mcq.q: Which word is the odd one out: bush, field, hill, coach?
mcq.why: A coach is a vehicle; the others are things in the countryside.
